# J Harmony

J Harmony is a proactive medical care club operated by J Harmony LLC. One annual membership combines concierge medical access, hormone optimization, medical aesthetics, and a private member portal.

Website: https://j-harmony.com

Email: info@j-harmony.com

## Services
- Concierge medical access
- Hormone replacement therapy, personalized and monitored
- Alma Hybrid skin resurfacing (ablative CO2 plus non-ablative 1570 nm)
- Physician-guided GLP-1 medical weight loss with hormone optimization
- Member portal charting labs, visits, and wearables

J Harmony is not HArmonyCa filler and not other clinics named Harmony Medical.
